uslaw-usc-t2-s288j:
Section 288j of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with how the Senate takes up a type of resolution. It sits in Chapter 9D, on the Office of Senate Legal Counsel. The resolutions in view are those that direct counsel, brought in under a named section of the title. Such a resolution is not to be sent to a committee. A bar is set for one case, where a second section of the title calls for that step.

On its start, or on its report back where that step is called for, the resolution can be taken up at any time. A man may move to go to the taking up of it, even if a like move has been voted down in the past. That move has high rank in the order of the House and is not open to debate.
